sections.executiveSummary: Blended holistic evaluation across Google, Meta, and TikTok paid media channels.
sections.overallScore: Omnichannel performance index (0-100) reflecting blended ROAS vs target profit floors.
sections.findings: Channel contribution analysis, budget split execution, and customer acquisition cross-pollination.
sections.issues: Channel attribution overlap, competing budget requests, and over-reliance on a single channel.
sections.recommendations: Cross-platform budget reallocations shifting spend to highest marginal ROAS platforms.
sections.priorityMatrix: Capital allocation priority matrix balancing scaling vs channel diversification.
sections.actionPlan: Weekly channel spend shift schedule and KPI monitoring checkpoints.
sections.supportingEvidence: Cross-platform comparison matrices (Spend, Blended CPA, Platform ROAS, MER).
sections.appendix: Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER) formulas, attribution methodology, and platform exchange rates.
